tool.name: GeneFior Combine
tool.description: Combine per-sample detection matrices into combined matrices
tool.command: ## Reconstruct per-sample result directories from provided detection matrices mkdir -p input_root/sample_1 && cp '$detection_matrix_1' input_root/sample_1/sample_1_detection_matrix.tsv && #if $evidence_matrix_1: cp '$evidence_matrix_1' input_root/sample_1/sample_1_evidence_matrix.tsv && #end if #if $detection_matrix_2: mkdir -p input_root/sample_2 && cp '$detection_matrix_2' input_root/sample_2/sample_2_detection_matrix.tsv && #if $evidence_matrix_2: cp '$evidence_matrix_2' input_root/sample_2/sample_2_evidence_matrix.tsv && #end if #end if #if $samples_file: cp '$samples_file' input_root/samples.txt && #end if GeneFior-Combine -i input_root #if $samples_file: --samples-file input_root/samples.txt #end if --output output_combined #if $verbose: --verbose #end if && find output_combined -name '*_combined_detection_matrix.tsv' | head -1 | xargs -I{} cp {} ../combined_detection_matrix.tsv && find output_combined -name '*_combined_detection_matrix_tools.tsv' | head -1 | xargs -I{} cp {} ../combined_detection_matrix_tools.tsv && find output_combined -name '*_combined_evidence_matrix.tsv' | head -1 | xargs -I{} cp {} ../combined_evidence_matrix.tsv

param.name: detection_matrix_1
param.label: Detection matrix (sample 1)
param.help: The *_detection_matrix.tsv file from the first sample's GeneFíor run

param.name: evidence_matrix_1
param.label: Evidence matrix (sample 1)
param.help: The *_evidence_matrix.tsv file from the first sample

param.name: detection_matrix_2
param.label: Detection matrix (sample 2)
param.help: The *_detection_matrix.tsv file from the second sample's GeneFíor run

param.name: evidence_matrix_2
param.label: Evidence matrix (sample 2)
param.help: The *_evidence_matrix.tsv file from the second sample

param.name: samples_file
param.label: Samples file
param.help: File with sample folder names (one per line). If not provided, all subdirectories are used.

tool.help:
@GENEFIOR_HELP@
**Combine**
GeneFior-Combine merges per-sample detection and evidence matrices from multiple GeneFíor or AMRfior runs into combined matrices. Provide the detection matrix (and optionally the evidence matrix) for each sample.
Optionally, provide a samples file listing the sample folder names to include (one per line). If omitted, all subdirectories are processed.
**Outputs:**
- **Combined detection matrix** — Gene × Sample detection results - **Combined detection matrix (per tool)** — Gene × Sample × Tool detection results - **Combined evidence matrix** — Gene × Sample evidence qualification levels
@ATTRIBUTION@
